# Repository instructions bridge

@../AGENTS.md

The provider-neutral repository contract is [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
Read it in full before planning, running commands, editing files, or delegating
work, and follow the role-specific file in `.github/agents/` when one is active.

If this client cannot load `AGENTS.md`, stop and tell the human; do not substitute
chat history, model defaults or silence. In particular, no implementation may
start without exact design ancestry. Agent-authored design is provisional,
requires the disclosures defined in `docs/DESIGN.md`, and permits only recorded,
reversible hands-off work until a human confirms the design and the next
hard-to-undo commitment.
